facts: Parties: Ingleby Analytics Ltd (Buyer), Orwell Engineering Ltd (Seller); the Company is Kingsmere Media Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 3 January 2027; Closing is scheduled for 7 April 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $5,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.

Section 9.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $5,625,000. The Purchase Price is $45,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $6,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $2,200,000.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Yarrow Analytics Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
